packet_dag.terminal_condition: The OneTime public landing aliases, especially /rabbi, render the focused OneTime public funnel without BNA preview chrome, and the public helper presents as Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant while keeping lead capture, helper memory, transcript knowledge, and WhatsApp readiness scoped to OneTime/Rabbi.

title: OneTime Rabbi Public Assistant Isolation

reasons: The live /rabbi alias was observed serving the older BNA provider-preview page while / and /one-time served the focused OneTime landing.
The operator explicitly corrected the public helper identity from generic One Time/BNA helper to Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant.
The request mentions WhatsApp lead capture and transcript knowledge, but external sends and knowledge promotion must remain guarded by existing OneTime WAPI and transcript decisions.
affected_product_surfaces: OneTime public landing and public helper bubble
likely_external_provider_blockers: Real WhatsApp send/connect remains blocked until OneTime/Rabbi WAPI credentials, class-link env, and final approval are present.
Transcript-derived helper knowledge remains blocked until approved transcript promotion policy and source review are complete.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: After this route/helper patch deploys, run live browser readback for /, /one-time, and /rabbi plus the OneTime helper open state; then leave WAPI and transcript promotion blocked until their existing decisions are resolved.

operator_intent_summary: The public Rabbi Scheller / OneTime experience must not look like BNA. The main public aliases must show the OneTimeOneTime Mishnayos landing, and the floating helper must introduce itself as Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant, help with schedule/program/speaking to the Rabbi, capture leads safely, and keep all knowledge and actions inside the Rabbi Sheller provider workspace.
raw_quotes: right now in the main landing page it's BNA
we can't have any BNA anywhere on the rabbi sheller thing
the bar is still programmed to BNA
that's the rabbi sheller digital assistant
the landing page it's going to be a little WhatsApp bubble that pops up
knowledge base is based on the transcript of the video
out_of_scope: No WAPI credential storage or external account mutation.
No Drive, Vimeo, transcript, or bot-knowledge promotion write.
No payment, access grant, DNS, Zoom, or email send.
No broad redesign of parent, student, member, or provider portals.
affected_surfaces: Route and action registries for the public helper

inspection_targets: server.js one_time_public assistant system prompt and action reply
observed: Live / and /one-time served the focused OneTime public landing with no BNA nav marker.
Live /rabbi served the older public/rabbi.html preview with BNA wording such as BNA provider system and preview mode.
The helper widget already normalizes /rabbi and /one-time to one_time_public, but visible copy says One Time Helper instead of Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant.
The generic BNA helper knowledge bundle is still loaded on OneTime pages and must not be the source for one_time_public helper choices or nudges.
known_blockers: Real WhatsApp/WAPI send remains blocked by missing OneTime WAPI credential setup and class-link env.
Transcript/Vimeo knowledge promotion remains blocked by the existing approved transcript policy decision.

trigger_phrases: bar is still programmed to BNA

expanded_phrases.BNA: For OneTime public surfaces, no visible BNA/BNA Academy brand, preview language, generic BNA homepage bar, BNA helper identity, or BNA public-program choices may appear.
expanded_phrases.bar is still programmed to BNA: The /rabbi public alias must use the same focused OneTime landing route as /one-time instead of public/rabbi.html preview chrome.
expanded_phrases.bot scoped: The assistant request surface must normalize to one_time_public, project_key one_time_mishnah_class, workspace_key rabbi_sheller_provider, and public OneTime-safe data only.
expanded_phrases.WhatsApp bubble: The visible helper bubble may capture schedule/program/speak-to-Rabbi lead intent into first-party CRM, but no external WhatsApp send is allowed without the existing WAPI gates.
expanded_phrases.CRM: Lead capture means first-party assistant/contact/ticket logging under OneTime scope, not GHL/LeadConnector or a generic BNA contact path.
expanded_phrases.knowledge base: OneTime helper context must be limited to approved OneTime public content and later approved transcript summaries, never generic BNA school knowledge.
expanded_phrases.transcript: Raw class transcripts stay private until a separate approved promotion policy produces reviewed summaries or class-session knowledge rows.

product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use existing first-party assistant threads, lead/ticket capture, route registry, action registry, and OneTime WAPI readiness gates. Do not introduce GHL/LeadConnector or direct WhatsApp sends in this packet.

requirements.statement: Rabbi / OneTime public aliases must render the focused OneTime public funnel and the public helper must present as Rabbi Scheller's digital assistant.
requirements.expected_result: Opening /, /one-time, and /rabbi on the OneTime single-tenant domain shows OneTimeOneTime Mishnayos public copy with no BNA preview wording; opening the helper shows Rabbi Scheller Assistant copy, schedule/program/speak-to-Rabbi actions, and one_time_public scope.
acceptance_criteria: /rabbi no longer serves public/rabbi.html preview content on the OneTime service.
The OneTime public helper visible launcher/title says Rabbi Scheller Assistant or Rabbi Scheller digital assistant.
OneTime public helper choices do not include Learn about BNA, How BNA works, BNA model path, service-provider ecosystem path, or generic BNA signup choices.
Assistant server prompt for one_time_public names Rabbi Scheller digital assistant and forbids BNA Academy, private portal, admin, and external-send claims.
Lead capture remains first-party and no WhatsApp/WAPI external send is performed in this packet.

criteria: Live current-state readback identified /rabbi as the BNA preview leak while / and /one-time were clean.
Memory confirms OneTime/Rabbi uses black/yellow branding and must remain scoped to rabbi_sheller_provider / one_time_mishnah_class.
External sends and transcript knowledge promotion are explicitly out of scope and blocked by existing decisions.
